name: sha1_digest
title: Hash an object that cannot hold attributes

origin.description: Call digest on an object that cannot take the sha1 attribute. name and NULL use this path.
origin.details: digits and zapsmall are not applied. The object is passed to digest unchanged.

translation.description: Call digest without attaching an attribute.
translation.details: The hash is digest of the object. digits and zapsmall do not change it.
